last_train.title: Last Train
last_train.line: If you get on that train, don't come back.
last_train.translation: Si te subes a ese tren, no regreses.
last_train.direction: A woman on a train platform, voice shaking with hurt but completely firm. Slow, deliberate, a short pause after 'train'.

fashionably_late.title: Fashionably Late
fashionably_late.line: I'm not late. Everyone else is just early.
fashionably_late.translation: No llegué tarde. Los demás llegaron temprano.
fashionably_late.direction: A charming man walking into a party late, totally unbothered, smiling as he talks. Light, playful rhythm.

rooftop.title: Rooftop
rooftop.line: I almost said it a hundred times. I love you.
rooftop.translation: Casi te lo dije cien veces. Te quiero.
rooftop.direction: Quiet, nervous and sincere, as if finally admitting something. Small breath before 'I love you', said softly.

countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.line: We have ninety seconds. Grab the bag and run!
countdown.translation: Tenemos noventa segundos. ¡Agarra la bolsa y corre!
countdown.direction: Urgent and commanding, a leader in a crisis. Fast pace, sharp consonants, rising energy on 'run'.

locked_door.title: The Locked Door
locked_door.line: Someone was in this house. The door was locked.
locked_door.translation: Alguien estuvo en esta casa. La puerta estaba cerrada.
locked_door.direction: A frightened whisper in a dark house. Slow, hushed, a pause between the two sentences.

first_day.title: First Day
first_day.line: Hi! I'm new. Is it always this loud in here?
first_day.translation: ¡Hola! Soy nuevo. ¿Siempre hay tanto ruido aquí?
first_day.direction: Cheerful but a little nervous, someone on their first day at a busy job. Friendly, slightly fast.

the_promise.title: The Promise
the_promise.line: I'll come back for you. I promise.
the_promise.translation: Volveré por ti. Te lo prometo.
the_promise.direction: Tender and steady, a parent saying goodbye. Warm, low, unhurried.

no_signal.title: No Signal
no_signal.line: No signal. No road. And the gas is almost gone.
no_signal.translation: Sin señal. Sin camino. Y casi no queda gasolina.
no_signal.direction: Tense and controlled, a driver lost at night trying not to panic. Clipped phrases, worry growing on the last part.

champion.title: Champion
champion.line: Nobody believed in us. Look at us now!
champion.direction: Triumphant and emotional, a team captain after a win. Loud, proud, almost laughing on 'now'.

wrong_number.title: Wrong Number
wrong_number.line: Sorry, who is this? Why do you have my dog?
wrong_number.translation: Perdón, ¿quién habla? ¿Por qué tiene a mi perro?
wrong_number.direction: Confused and increasingly alarmed on a phone call. Polite at first, then rising disbelief on 'my dog'.

the_storm.title: The Storm
the_storm.line: Hold on to the rope! Don't look down!
the_storm.direction: Shouting over a storm to someone in danger. Loud, strong, urgent but encouraging.

the_letter.title: The Letter
the_letter.line: I read your letter. Every word. Twice.
the_letter.translation: Leí tu carta. Cada palabra. Dos veces.
the_letter.direction: Quiet and sad, holding back tears. Slow, with pauses between each short sentence.

interrogation.title: Interrogation
interrogation.line: You were there that night. Stop lying to me.
interrogation.translation: Estabas ahí esa noche. Deja de mentirme.
interrogation.direction: A detective, cold and intense, leaning in. Low voice, very controlled, hard stress on 'lying'.

surprise.title: Surprise
surprise.line: Close your eyes. Okay... now open them!
surprise.direction: Excited and playful, about to reveal a surprise. Hushed first sentence, a pause, then a burst of joy.

the_deal.title: The Deal
the_deal.line: Ten thousand. Final offer. Take it or leave it.
the_deal.translation: Diez mil. Última oferta. Lo tomas o lo dejas.
the_deal.direction: A calm, confident negotiator. Slow and certain, each phrase landing like a decision.

lost_city.title: Lost City
lost_city.line: Do you see that? It's real. It's actually real.
lost_city.translation: ¿Ves eso? Es real. Es de verdad real.
lost_city.direction: Breathless wonder, an explorer seeing something incredible. Soft at first, building to amazement.

the_apology.title: The Apology
the_apology.line: I was wrong. I'm sorry. Please don't go.
the_apology.translation: Me equivoqué. Lo siento. Por favor, no te vayas.
the_apology.direction: Regretful and vulnerable, pleading gently. Quiet, a catch in the voice on 'please'.

midnight_call.title: Midnight Call
midnight_call.line: Don't open the door. Whatever you hear, don't open it.
midnight_call.translation: No abras la puerta. Oigas lo que oigas, no la abras.
midnight_call.direction: Urgent and afraid on a late-night phone call. Hushed but intense, stressing 'don't'.

stand_up.title: Stand Up
stand_up.line: Tonight, we don't run. Tonight, we fight back.
stand_up.translation: Esta noche no huimos. Esta noche respondemos.
stand_up.direction: An inspiring speech to a crowd. Strong, rising energy, a pause between the two sentences.

coffee_shop.title: Coffee Shop
coffee_shop.line: Is this seat taken, or saved for me?
coffee_shop.translation: ¿Este asiento está ocupado, o lo guardas para mí?
coffee_shop.direction: Flirty and relaxed, smiling in a coffee shop. Easy, warm, a little teasing.

job_offer.title: The Offer
job_offer.line: They offered me the job in New York. I asked for one night to think.
job_offer.translation: Me ofrecieron el trabajo en Nueva York. Pedí una noche para pensarlo.
job_offer.direction: Excited and overwhelmed at the same time, telling a close friend. Fast at first, slowing down and unsure at the end.

the_heist.title: The Plan
the_heist.line: Nobody touches the alarm. Nobody uses real names. We're in and out in four minutes.
the_heist.translation: Nadie toca la alarma. Nadie usa nombres reales. Entramos y salimos en cuatro minutos.
the_heist.direction: A calm crew leader giving final instructions. Low, steady, every sentence clipped and certain.

old_friends.title: Old Friends
old_friends.line: You haven't changed at all. You're still the worst driver I have ever met.
old_friends.translation: No has cambiado nada. Sigues siendo el peor conductor que he conocido.
old_friends.direction: Two old friends reunited. Warm, laughing, affectionate teasing; a big smile you can hear.

good_news.title: Good News
good_news.line: The doctor says she's going to be fine. I can finally breathe again.
good_news.translation: El doctor dice que ella va a estar bien. Por fin puedo respirar otra vez.
good_news.direction: Overwhelming relief after a long, scary night. Shaky at first, then a long exhale and a soft laugh.

blind_date.title: Blind Date
blind_date.line: I'll be honest, I almost cancelled tonight. But I'm really glad I didn't.
blind_date.translation: Te seré honesto, casi cancelo esta noche. Pero me alegra mucho no haberlo hecho.
blind_date.direction: Shy and honest on a first date. A little awkward at the start, warm and sincere at the end.

final_round.title: Final Round
final_round.line: Your legs are tired and your lungs are burning, but you are not done yet.
final_round.translation: Tus piernas están cansadas y tus pulmones arden, pero todavía no has terminado.
final_round.direction: A coach in the corner before the last round. Intense, close, building energy to 'not done yet'.

the_secret.title: The Secret
the_secret.line: If I tell you what I saw, you have to promise you'll never repeat it.
the_secret.translation: Si te digo lo que vi, tienes que prometer que nunca lo repetirás.
the_secret.direction: Hushed and serious, looking around before speaking. Slow, careful, low volume.

moving_out.title: Moving Out
moving_out.line: This apartment was too small, too loud, and the best home I ever had.
moving_out.translation: Este apartamento era muy pequeño, muy ruidoso, y el mejor hogar que he tenido.
moving_out.direction: Nostalgic, standing in an empty apartment. Amused at first, then soft and emotional on the last phrase.

lost_luggage.title: Lost Luggage
lost_luggage.line: So my suitcase went to Paris, and I went to Chicago. Great start to my vacation.
lost_luggage.translation: Así que mi maleta se fue a París, y yo a Chicago. Gran comienzo de mis vacaciones.
lost_luggage.direction: Frustrated but trying to laugh about it at an airport desk. Dry, tired, comic timing on the last sentence.

the_pilot.title: Mayday
the_pilot.line: We lost engine two. I'm going to land this plane, so everybody hold on.
the_pilot.translation: Perdimos el motor dos. Voy a aterrizar este avión, así que todos agárrense.
the_pilot.direction: A pilot in an emergency, impossibly calm and clear. Even pace, reassuring, firm on 'hold on'.

missed_games.title: Missed Games
missed_games.line: I wasn't there for your games, and I'm sorry. Let me be there now.
missed_games.translation: No estuve en tus partidos, y lo siento. Déjame estar ahora.
missed_games.direction: A father apologizing to his grown son. Slow, heavy with regret, hopeful at the end.

the_window.title: The Window
the_window.line: The window was broken from the inside. Whoever did this never left the house.
the_window.translation: La ventana se rompió desde adentro. Quien hizo esto nunca salió de la casa.
the_window.direction: A detective figuring it out in real time. Thoughtful, then a chill of realization on the second sentence.

wedding_toast.title: The Toast
wedding_toast.line: When they first met, she said he was annoying. Clearly, she was half right.
wedding_toast.translation: Cuando se conocieron, ella dijo que él era molesto. Claramente, tenía media razón.
wedding_toast.direction: A best friend giving a wedding toast. Warm and confident, pausing for the laugh after 'half right'.

night_shift.title: Night Shift
night_shift.line: I work two jobs so you can have the chances I never had.
night_shift.translation: Trabajo en dos empleos para que tengas las oportunidades que yo nunca tuve.
night_shift.direction: A tired mother speaking to her teenager, quietly but with deep intensity. No shouting, every word meant.

the_audition.title: The Audition
the_audition.line: I've practiced this every night for a year. Please, just give me one chance.
the_audition.translation: Lo he practicado cada noche durante un año. Por favor, solo dame una oportunidad.
the_audition.direction: Desperate but dignified, asking for one more chance. Voice slightly trembling, strong on 'one chance'.

oxygen_low.title: Oxygen Low
oxygen_low.line: Oxygen is at forty percent. If we don't fix this now, we won't get another try.
oxygen_low.translation: El oxígeno está al cuarenta por ciento. Si no arreglamos esto ahora, no habrá otro intento.
oxygen_low.direction: An astronaut in a failing station, tense but focused. Quick, clear, controlled fear.

first_dance.title: First Dance
first_dance.line: I don't know how to dance. Teach me, and I promise not to step on you.
first_dance.translation: No sé bailar. Enséñame, y prometo no pisarte.
first_dance.direction: Playful and a little embarrassed, inviting someone to dance. Light, smiling, gentle laugh at the end.

the_rival.title: The Rival
the_rival.line: You beat me last year. This year, I came here ready for you.
the_rival.translation: Me ganaste el año pasado. Este año vine preparado para ti.
the_rival.direction: Face to face with a rival before the match. Calm, confident, a quiet threat in the second sentence.

runaway.title: Runaway
runaway.line: Leave your phone, take only cash, and don't tell anyone where you're going.
runaway.translation: Deja tu teléfono, lleva solo efectivo y no le digas a nadie a dónde vas.
runaway.direction: An urgent whisper, helping someone escape. Fast, low, each instruction separated.

grandmas_kitchen.title: Grandma's Kitchen
grandmas_kitchen.line: She taught me to cook without a recipe. Just taste it, and trust yourself.
grandmas_kitchen.translation: Ella me enseñó a cocinar sin receta. Solo pruébalo, y confía en ti.
grandmas_kitchen.direction: Warm and loving, remembering a grandmother. Soft smile in the voice, slower on the last sentence.

boardroom.title: The Boardroom
boardroom.line: Let's not beat around the bush. The numbers are bad, and someone dropped the ball.
boardroom.translation: No demos rodeos. Los números son malos y alguien cometió un error grave.
boardroom.direction: A blunt executive in a tense meeting. Direct, fast, no warmth; stress on 'dropped the ball'.

roommate.title: The Roommate
roommate.line: Oh, great, you finished the milk again. Truly, you're a gift to this apartment.
roommate.translation: Ah, genial, otra vez te acabaste la leche. De verdad, eres un regalo para este apartamento.
roommate.direction: Heavy, dry sarcasm. Fake cheerful tone that clearly means the opposite; slow on 'truly'.

the_comeback.title: The Comeback
the_comeback.line: Everyone wrote me off. Funny thing is, I was just getting started.
the_comeback.translation: Todos me dieron por acabado. Lo curioso es que apenas estaba empezando.
the_comeback.direction: Cool, quiet confidence after proving everyone wrong. Relaxed pace, a small smile on 'funny thing is'.

cold_feet.title: Cold Feet
cold_feet.line: I'm not getting cold feet. I'm just... reconsidering every decision I've ever made.
cold_feet.translation: No me estoy arrepintiendo. Solo estoy... reconsiderando cada decisión que he tomado.
cold_feet.direction: Nervous groom or bride rambling before the ceremony. Fast, breathless, comic pause before 'reconsidering'.

the_bluff.title: The Bluff
the_bluff.line: You're bluffing. I can read you like a book, and it's a very short book.
the_bluff.translation: Estás fanfarroneando. Te leo como un libro, y es un libro muy corto.
the_bluff.direction: Smug and amused at a card table. Slow, enjoying every word, a slight laugh on 'very short'.

done_waiting.title: Done Waiting
done_waiting.line: I've bent over backwards for this company, and I'm done biting my tongue.
done_waiting.translation: Me he esforzado al máximo por esta empresa, y ya no me voy a quedar callado.
done_waiting.direction: Controlled anger finally released in an office. Firm, rising, sharp on 'done'.

lucky.title: Lucky
lucky.line: Go ahead and call it luck, if that helps you sleep at night.
lucky.translation: Adelante, llámalo suerte, si eso te ayuda a dormir por las noches.
lucky.direction: Cool and cutting, a quiet put-down to a rival. Low, unhurried, a hint of a smile.
idioms: if it helps you sleep at night
